descriptions.description: A worked GraphRAG benchmark dataset: a content-addressed corpus, its chunking, embeddings, vector index, retrieval events, and model-extracted entity/relationship descriptions — every artifact attributed and confidence-weighted, published as a research object.

Generated lossy projection of canonical GMEOW instance data. Drops: reified relators (Copyright, roles, memberships) flatten or vanish; RDF 1.2 statement annotations (confidence, accordingTo, the four clocks) are dropped; standpoint indexing is dropped — contested claims appear without their vantage; blake3 content digests cannot fill sha256-only slots; the verbatim digest is preserved where the format allows.
